- .github/workflows/ci.yml:293-296 | hardening suggestion (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE=1)
  PROBLEM: The comment claims "--retry-delay 0 keeps curl's built-in exponential backoff", but `--retry-delay 0` overrides curl's default exponential backoff with a constant zero-second delay, so retries fire back-to-back.
  WHY: The comment is misleading; the combined budget comes from `--max-time 120` per attempt (up to 4 attempts = ~480s worst case), not from any inter-attempt sleep. Suggested fix: remove the misleading half of the comment, or drop `--retry-delay 0` (smaller change).
